claims.statement: Newspapers had written that Sherman Thurston was Tom Allen's trainer; the Globe-Democrat says Thurston never was, and that Allen was afraid of him.
claims.excerpt: He had been written up as the trainer of Tom Allen. He never was.

notes: The 'afraid' part is in the same passage but is damaged in OCR ('afraidjof'); the excerpt stops before it. Allen appears only in this passage.
